findings.summary: The Log contact route moved to /people/:id/events/new, but the Today card's Log contact affordance still navigates to the removed /people/:id/log route.
The new HistoryRow.open affordance navigates to /people/:id/events/:eventId, but no screen declares that route, so the revision target is undefined.
findings.evidence: effects: [Navigates to /people/:id/events/:eventId to revise the event] — screen routes are /signin, /today, /people, /people/:id, /people/:id/goal, /people/:id/events/new, /connect/:token, /settings
